title: fix(plugin-audit): mark in-product AI calls on the action-invocation, data-export and dataset-query audit rows
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi99ewj5JRWXTB3u38E9HLhnj)_
Fixes #34556

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Spec surface: since round r2 this PR touches `packages/spec/src` (describe and JSDoc prose only, no key, type or refine), so it owes an L2 contract review and the seat's Tier H step before it lands.

## 维护者速读

1. **改了什么**：产品内 AI 替某人执行动作、导出数据、查询数据集时，这三类审计行现在和记录写入行一样，写明是哪个 AI（`performed_by`）、替谁（`on_behalf_of`）、在哪次对话（`conversation_id`）、经哪次确认（`confirmation_id`，没确认就不写）。spec 里描述这件事的说明文字同步改正（只改文字，不改字段）。
2. **为什么改**：之前这三类行只认 OAuth 客户端，产品内 AI 做的动作、导出、查询在审计日志里和本人亲手操作一模一样，查不到是哪次 AI 对话、哪次确认触发的。
3. **风险与回滚**：只在 metadata 里加键，`user_id` / `actor` 仍是本人；OAuth 客户端的行和本人亲手操作的行不变。四类行现在共用一个规则函数，记录写入行的行为不变（原有 15 条钉子测试全绿）。回滚即撤本 PR，历史行不受影响。
4. **先看**：`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.ts`（新的 `auditPerformerMetadata` 与记录写入处的调用）、`packages/spec/src/kernel/execution-context.zod.ts`（`performedBy` 的 describe 与 JSDoc 改句）、三个写入器各自的一行接线与三个测试文件末尾新增的 describe。
5. **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit exec vitest run src/action-invocation-audit.test.ts src/data-export-audit.test.ts src/dataset-query-audit.test.ts src/agent-dual-attribution.integration.test.ts`，预期 4 个文件 62 条全绿，其中 9 条是本卡新用例。
6. **需要你做的**：本 PR 改了 `packages/spec/src` 的说明文字，契约复审（L2）通过后按席位的 Tier H 流程由你确认落地。

## What changes

- **One performer rule for every `sys_audit_log` writer.** PR #34547 wrote the in-product AI rule inline in the record-write writer (`installAuditWriters`), reading `HookContext.provenance` through a private reader. This PR moves that rule, unchanged, into one exported function in `audit-writers.ts`, `auditPerformerMetadata(performer, onBehalfOf)`, which takes the `ExecutionContext.performedBy` shape (`clientId`, `agentId`, `conversationId`, `confirmationId`) and returns the metadata keys or nothing. The record-write writer now calls it with its four `provenance` marks. The rule is the one #34547 settled:
  - `performed_by` is the OAuth client, else the in-product agent; `on_behalf_of` is the row's own `user_id` value;
  - `conversation_id` / `confirmation_id` are written only when the in-product agent is the recorded performer, each only when stamped;
  - an envelope naming both performers records the OAuth client and drops the agent with its two marks;
  - no performer ⇒ none of these keys.
- **The three writers apply it.** `action-invocation-audit.ts`, `data-export-audit.ts` and `dataset-query-audit.ts` read `performedBy.clientId` only. Each now calls `auditPerformerMetadata(ctx.performedBy, userId)` in place of its own two-key block. All three write `sys_audit_log` and keep `metadata` as one JSON text column, so no column or key is added. Their header comments now name the two marks.
- **`hook-bodies.mdx`.** The `ctx.provenance` table listed `performedByClientId` only. It now lists `performedByAgentId`, `performedByConversationId`, `performedByConfirmationId` and `impersonatedBy`, which the hook-body sandbox already copies (`packages/runtime/src/sandbox/body-runner.ts`). `performedByAgentId` is included because the other two are defined as set beside it.
- **Spec describes (round r2).** `packages/spec/src/kernel/execution-context.zod.ts`: the `performedBy` describe and JSDoc said "The action-invocation, data-export and dataset-query rows record clientId only", which this PR makes false. They now say those rows "record the performer and the two marks by the same rule". The reader rule there, and in `packages/spec/src/data/hook.zod.ts`'s `performedByAgentId` describe, also takes the L2 nit N3 from record 6937613475: "where both tells apply the mark decides, and a matching value with no mark is the client unless an agent shares that string". No key, type, refine or optionality moves. `content/docs/references/**` regenerated (`gen:docs`): `kernel/execution-context.mdx`, `data/data-engine.mdx` (12 `performedBy` rows), `data/hook.mdx`.
- Changeset `.changeset/34556-audit-ai-marks-three-rows.md`: `@objectstack/plugin-audit` patch, `@objectstack/spec` patch (describe text ships).

`auditPerformerMetadata` is exported from the module, not from the package entry (`src/index.ts` is unchanged), so the published API surface does not change.

## Enumeration (from the card)

- [x] action-invocation audit row: pinned by `action-invocation-audit.test.ts` › "[#33694] an in-product AI call is marked on the action_invocation row by the CRUD mirror's rule" (the AI row is written and read back through a real ObjectQL engine).
- [x] data-export audit row: pinned by `data-export-audit.test.ts` › "[#33694] an in-product AI export is marked on the export row by the CRUD mirror's rule".
- [x] dataset-query audit row: pinned by `dataset-query-audit.test.ts` › "[#33694] an in-product AI query is marked on the dataset_query row by the CRUD mirror's rule".
- [x] `hook-bodies.mdx`: the `ctx.provenance` table lists `performedByConversationId` and `performedByConfirmationId` (and `performedByAgentId`, and since L1 R1 `impersonatedBy`) beside `performedByClientId`. Docs only, no test.

## Tests

Each of the three describes has three cases:

- An AI-performed call (`performedBy: { agentId, conversationId, confirmationId }`) records `performed_by` = agent, `on_behalf_of` = person, `conversation_id`, `confirmation_id`; `user_id` stays the person.
- CONTROL: an OAuth client with a conversation and a confirmation, and an envelope naming both a client and an agent, each record only `{ performed_by: client, on_behalf_of }` and no marks.
- CONTROL: a person's own call carries none of the four keys.

No existing test changed. `agent-dual-attribution.integration.test.ts` (the record-write pins #34547 added) passes unchanged against the extracted function.

## Acceptance notes

- **Round r2 (seat chose option A).** The spec sentence this PR made false is corrected in this PR, as described above, instead of in a follow-up card. `hook.zod.ts` carried no "clientId only" claim; it is touched only to carry N3 in the third place the reader rule is stated.
- **L1 R1 (record 6941727354).** The `ctx.provenance` table in `hook-bodies.mdx` now also lists `impersonatedBy`, which the sandbox copies (`packages/runtime/src/sandbox/body-runner.ts`), so every member it carries has a row. Commit `f62fa7ad00`, one docs line.
- Merge probe against PR #34545 (`claude/project-thread-l1nf08`, which also edits `hook-bodies.mdx`): `git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only HEAD origin/claude/project-thread-l1nf08` reports `Auto-merging content/docs/automation/hook-bodies.mdx` with no conflict in that file. The one textual conflict it reports, `packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json`, is between #34545 and `main` and is not in this diff. The three-ref form in the dispatch (`git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main HEAD BRANCH`) is not valid syntax and exits 129, so the two-ref form was used. This is a local probe with the repo's merge driver registered, not GitHub's mergeability.

## Verification

<details><summary>Round r2, at head 5f005fb26a (after merging origin/main twice)</summary>

- Commits: `49dc838adb` (spec prose: the two spec files), `c5eafdb182` (regenerated references), `19d92fd27e` (changeset), then the merge of `origin/main` at `5f005fb26a`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` under the lock: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:docs`: exit 0, three reference pages changed (14 lines). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date", exit 0. The first attempt reported `test-typecheck-debt.json` with "tsc -p tsconfig.test.json failed without diagnostics": a JavaScript heap OOM under the 4096 MB default on this shared box, not staleness. It was re-run with `--max-old-space-size=6144`, and the later gate sweep at 4096 was green too.
- No remaining copy of "record clientId only" in `packages/spec/src` or `content/docs/references`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/kernel/execution-context.test.ts src/data/hook.test.ts`: Test Files 2 passed (2), Tests 146 passed (146).
- plugin-audit after the final merge: closure build exit 0; `vitest run --maxWorkers=2` gives Test Files 101 passed (101), Tests 1696 passed (1696); typecheck exit 0.
- Full workspace build (`turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter=!@objectstack/docs`): 119 of 119 tasks successful.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 119 commands at this head. All ran with stdin closed and the exit taken before any pipe; all exited 0. `--ran`: "119 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 119 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".

</details>

Round 1 readings below were taken at head `41a26f1134` (after merging `origin/main` `e5336512f`). The plugin-audit code has not changed since.

- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/plugin-audit^...' build` under the verify lock: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/action-invocation-audit.test.ts src/data-export-audit.test.ts src/dataset-query-audit.test.ts src/agent-dual-attribution.integration.test.ts`: Test Files 4 passed (4), Tests 62 passed (62).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` (whole package): Test Files 101 passed (101), Tests 1696 passed (1696).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit typecheck`: exit 0; `check:test-typecheck: OK`, 0 errors.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; tests import the writers from src)</summary>

Each writer's wiring `Object.assign(metadata, auditPerformerMetadata(ctx.performedBy, userId));` replaced by the old client-only reading `auditPerformerMetadata({ clientId: ctx.performedBy?.clientId }, userId)`. Anchor 1 → 0 each time; restored blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty each time.

- `action-invocation-audit.ts` → its pin "an AI-performed call records the agent, the person, the conversation and the confirmation" FAILS: Tests 1 failed / 13 passed (14).
- `data-export-audit.ts` → "an AI-performed export records …" FAILS: Tests 1 failed / 18 passed (19).
- `dataset-query-audit.ts` → "an AI-performed query records …" FAILS: Tests 1 failed / 13 passed (14).

The shared rule in `audit-writers.ts`: `agentIsRecordedPerformer = !performedByClientId && performedByAgentId !== undefined` replaced by `performedBy !== undefined`, run over the four files: Tests 5 failed / 57 passed (62). The three new CONTROL pins (client alone or beside an agent) fail, and so do #34547's two record-write pins ("never ride beside an OAuth client id", "an envelope naming both performers"). Restored blob == HEAD.

</details>

- Not run locally, left to CI: the repo-wide scans, `test:repo`, and the dogfood battery. The title has no `!` and the claim has no `(narrowing)` arm.

</details>
